en.backendCdpHint: Drive an already-running browser over its DevTools Protocol port.
en.backendLocalHint: Launch a browser through the local playwright installation.
en.cdpEndpointHint: host:port or http(s)/ws URL. Leave blank for 127.0.0.1:9222.
en.challengeWaitMsHint: Bounded wait for a Cloudflare challenge to clear naturally in the same tab (0–60000; 0 = off). 0 disables: the first response is returned as-is.
en.denoiseHint: Readability + DOMPurify strip nav bars, sidebars, footers, and ads before converting to markdown.
en.description: Fetches pages with a real browser (local Playwright or CDP) and returns denoised markdown.
en.invalidText: This value is not accepted here.
en.maxConcurrencyHint: How many pages may render at once (1–200). Blank = auto: 4 local browsers, 50 CDP tabs in the remote browser.
en.playwrightPathHint: Leave blank to find playwright on $PATH; a browser executable path also works.
en.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
en.shareBrowserContextHint: Each fetch opens a tab in the remote browser’s real profile — cookies and localStorage are shared and its persistent logins apply. Unchecked: every fetch uses a fresh isolated context.
